speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of allergic rhinitis, eczema, or seasonal allergies, and do you experience nasal congestion or itchy eyes alongside your respiratory symptoms? REQUEST TEST: Total_IgE and FeNO (Fractional exhaled Nitric Oxide) levels. Also, have you noticed any improvement in your symptoms when you take antihistamines or nasal steroids?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal IgE and FeNO levels, allergic asthma seems unlikely. Do you experience symptoms like heartburn, regurgitation, or a sour taste in your mouth, especially when lying down or after meals? REQUEST TEST: Esophageal pH monitoring. Also, have you noticed any relief of your cough when you elevate your head or take antacids?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (Adult-onset or late-onset asthma). The combination of a chronic productive cough, significant airflow obstruction that is partially reversible with bronchodilators, and the absence of allergic markers or GERD symptoms strongly points to asthma. While your history of factory work raises suspicion for occupational lung disease, the normal chest X-ray and the specific reversibility pattern are classic for asthma. I recommend starting a trial of inhaled corticosteroids to see if your symptoms resolve.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
